meta.title: Exotour — Hiking made accessible to everyone
meta.description: Exotour equips your agency's groups with walking-assist exoskeletons and provides full on-site supervision, with no equipment investment from you.

hero.title: Hiking made accessible to everyone, with no investment on your part.
hero.subtitle: Exotour equips your groups with walking-assist exoskeletons and provides full on-site supervision — you keep your catalogue, your brand and your customer relationship.

about.title: Giving movement back to those who set it aside
about.body: Exotour was born from a simple conviction: difficulty walking should never be the reason someone gives up on discovering a place. We equip hikers with discreet walking assistance, and put this technology at the service of agencies already building trips across Europe.

home.imageAlt: A senior hiking couple wearing their exoskeletons, smiling, in a mountain landscape

difference.title: An immediate point of difference, with no investment on your part
difference.calloutTitle: You buy nothing, you add an activity
difference.calloutBody: No equipment to acquire, no staff to train, no risk to carry alone: Exotour arrives with its own supervision and insurance. You get to offer an experience few agencies in Europe provide today.

hero.title: About us
hero.subtitle: Giving movement back to those who set it aside.

conviction.title: Difficulty walking should never be the reason someone gives up on discovering a place
conviction.body: We equip hikers with discreet walking assistance, and put this technology at the service of agencies already building trips across Europe.

about.notBody: We do not sell equipment. We are not an exoskeleton manufacturer looking for distributors.
about.areBody: We provide a complete experience — device, supervision, safety — designed to give hikers held back by mobility the simple pleasure of moving forward on a trail, at a group's pace, without fear of falling behind.
about.imageAlt: A group of hikers sitting in a circle, laughing together on a grassy summit at sunset

figures.title: The foundations of the offer at launch
figures.note: Launch figures for the offer — performance indicators (mobility, endurance, satisfaction) will be measured and published after the first pilot trips.

hero.title: Our technology
hero.subtitle: Discreet assistance, not heavy medical equipment.

how.title: Gear that wears like standard hiking equipment
how.body: The Exotour exoskeleton is worn like standard hiking equipment: a belt fitted at the waist, two straps running down the thighs to small, discreet actuators positioned on the side of the leg, just above the knee.

technology.imageAlt: A guide adjusts the exoskeleton on a hiker's leg before departure
technology.changesBody: Progressive assistance with every step, reducing perceived effort on climbs and protecting joints on descents — without blocking or forcing the natural movement of walking.
technology.notReplaceBody: This is not a medical device: every participant is assessed beforehand by our guide through a short comfort questionnaire, to make sure the chosen format suits them.
technology.supervisionBody: Each exoskeleton is individually fitted before departure by a guide trained in its use, present throughout the trip.

hero.title: An assisted-hiking module, ready to add to your catalogue
hero.subtitle: Three formats, one promise: walk without fear.

observation.title: Many hikers stay off the trails
observation.body: Joint pain, rehabilitation, breathlessness, fear of fatigue: a significant share of tourism and travel agency clients give up on the hikes in their catalogue, not feeling able to keep up with the group.

concept.clientProblemBody: They would like to take part, but choose a more sedentary activity instead — or give up on the active trip altogether.
concept.agencyProblemBody: An entire segment of your clientele (seniors, spa-goers, people in gentle rehabilitation) remains out of reach of your current hiking offer.

included.title: An all-inclusive package, per group
items: Rental and individual fitting of the exoskeleton for each participant
Accompanying guide trained in exoskeleton use
Route adapted to the terrain and the group's profile
Meal or snack break depending on the package
Equipment transport to the starting point

items.name: Discovery
items.description: Flat terrain, short loop, one or two scenic stops. A gentle first experience, ideal for a free afternoon during a trip.

items.name: Nature immersion
items.description: Longer trail, gentle elevation gain, picnic included. The most requested format for a spa or nature trip.

items.name: Themed stay
items.description: Assisted hiking combined with gentle activities (wellness, local discovery). A higher average ticket for your agency.

hero.title: What an Exotour day looks like
hero.subtitle: From welcoming the group to returning the equipment.

steps.title: Welcome and briefing
steps.description: Group introduction, comfort questionnaire, individual fitting of each exoskeleton.

steps.title: Guided familiarisation
steps.description: A few minutes of supervised walking before departure so everyone feels comfortable with the assistance.

steps.title: The hike
steps.description: The route at the group's own pace, regular breaks, a guide attentive to everyone's comfort.

steps.title: Return and debrief
steps.description: Equipment removal, feedback session, souvenir photos to share with your agency.

howItWorks.imageAlt: Aerial view of a line of hikers walking along a green ridge trail

summary.title: A day designed for confidence, not performance
summary.body: Every step is designed so the group moves at its own pace, with supervision present from the first step to the last — without ever turning the hike into a trial.

hero.title: A partnership designed to fit into your existing offer
hero.subtitle: You keep your catalogue, your brand and your customer relationship.

response.title: An assisted-hiking module, ready to integrate

items.title: You keep your catalogue and your brand
items.body: Exotour is added as an activity within a trip you already sell.

items.title: We bring the equipment and the expertise
items.body: Exoskeletons, individual fitting, trained guide, safety protocol.

items.title: You keep the customer relationship
items.body: We act as a technical provider, white-label if you prefer.

structure.title: A simple commitment model, with no imposed price grid
structure.body: The formula adapts to your volume of activity: a per-participant rate to get started, a flat fee for a full group on a guaranteed date, or a seasonal commitment across several departures.
structure.exclusivityBody: For agencies committing to a volume of departures in advance, we can discuss territorial or seasonal exclusivity — so you are the only agency in your market offering Exotour to your clients.

ctaBand.title: Let's discuss your first pilot trip
ctaBand.body: We propose calibrating the offer with a first test group on one of your existing destinations, so we can jointly fine-tune onboarding time, on-the-ground logistics and conditions before a larger rollout.
